description: Discover the best hotels in Torquay, Australia. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Award-Winning Surf Coast Escape on Great Ocean Road with Daily Breakfast & Nightly Drinks
hotels.description: From world-class golf to acclaimed fine dining, this newly refurbished coastal resort offers unparalleled experiences just steps from the Great Ocean Road’s renowned surf beaches. Awarded the 2025 Tripadvisor Best of the Best title as one of Australia’s top hotels, RACV Torquay Resort has everything you could wish for. Start your holiday strong with a rejuvenating treatment at One Spa, or head to the pool for a few leisurely laps while the little ones enjoy the separate recreation area and wading pool. Perfect your swing at the 18-hole, par-71 golf course or stop by the tennis courts to work up a sweat - there’s something for the whole family here. When it’s time to indulge, treat your palate at Number One restaurant, unwind in the relaxed ambience of White’s Paddock, or soak up the sun and ocean views with a drink in hand at SeaSpray Co. When you're ready to discover the region, venture out to explore the Great Ocean Road, Bells Beach and the charming town of Torquay, all just a stone’s throw away.

hotels.title: Great Ocean Road Coastal Resort with 18-Hole Championship Course & Three Onsite Restaurants
hotels.description: Wind your way along the coast of Victoria to this coastal haven, elegantly perched on the northern headland of Torquay - the starting point of the Great Ocean Road. Spend your days exploring one of Australia's most famed stretches of coastline and come back to an expansive 25-metre heated indoor pool for a refreshing swim. Try your hand at a round of tennis or pull up a pew at the 20-metre-long Shirley’s bar and savour your favourite drink. The Sands Torquay is perched on an 18-hole championship golf course designed by former Australian professional golfer Stuart Appleby. Take the short drive into Torquay township where you'll find boutiques and gourmet bites or travel a little further afield to the wonders of the Great Ocean Road, including the the spectacular Twelve Apostles.

hotels.title: Great Ocean Road Coastal Torquay Escape with Outdoor Pool & Apartment Upgrades Available
hotels.description: Sitting right on Zeally Bay, Wyndham Resort Torquay puts rolling surf on your doorstep and the beach just a short walk over the dunes. Bells Beach - a favourite with families and home to world-class surfing - is less than 10 minutes away, placing you at the start of Victoria’s iconic Great Ocean Road. Back at the resort, a heated outdoor pool, indoor lap pool, tennis court, fitness centre and games room keep everyone entertained between beach trips. For extra space, upgrade to a fully equipped apartment - ideal for families wanting a relaxed home base for longer stays. Torquay's boutiques, cafes and the Surf World Museum are a short stroll across Surf Coast Highway. The resort's on-site Grab-and-Go Café keeps things simple, whether you're picking up coffee on the way out or pizza after a day in the surf.

hotels.title: Elegant Great Ocean Road Torquay Escape Steps from Zeally Bay Beach with Indoor Pool & Spa
hotels.description: Experience the sheer coastal bliss of Victoria's picturesque Surf Coast with an escape to this stylish retreat in Torquay, ideally sitting across Zeally Bay Beach. The perfect launchpad for exploring the unrivalled beauty of the Great Ocean Road, this resort offers a blend of modern comfort with classic charms, featuring spacious, well-appointed accommodations to ensure utmost relaxation. Take a dip in the heated indoor pool, pamper with treatments at the outdoor spa, play tennis or indulge in culinary delights at the onsite bar and cafe. From surf lessons, vibrant dining and farmers markets, to reef walks and fishing charters, you'll be perfectly placed to take advantage of everything the Great Ocean Road has to offer.
